output.subject: We've received your feedback about the Lantern Hill branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to contact us about the Lantern Hill branch. We have received your feedback, and we appreciate you sharing your thoughts with us.

You told us that you feel closing the Lantern Hill branch is unfair to the neighborhood. You mentioned that around half of the people who use the branch are older residents who walk there, and you shared your view that the bank will lose a lot of customers as a result.

We understand how much a local branch can mean to the people who use it, and we're sorry for the concern this has caused you. Your feedback, including what you've told us about the neighbors who rely on walking to the branch, has been passed to a specialist team, who are reviewing it now. They will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you again for letting us know how you feel.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm the current status of the Lantern Hill branch before replying; the draft neither confirms nor denies a closure.
The customer made no specific request; decide whether the reply should cover alternatives such as nearby branches or other ways to bank.
Check whether the customer is an account holder and whether they personally rely on the branch.
Consider whether this feedback about older residents who walk to the branch should go to whoever is handling the branch decision.
